name: Editable
purpose: Own inline preview/edit transactions, commit/cancel and focus without visual styling.
useWhen: An existing text value should become editable on demand and support cancellation.

avoidWhen.condition: A value is permanently shown as a form field.

composition: Use Root or RootProvider with Area, Preview and exactly one Input or Textarea. Provide Label or another accessible name; explicit controls are optional.

rules.statement: Treat onValueChange as draft changes and onValueCommit as a commit request; persistence belongs to the application.
Update controlled value/edit in their callbacks; refused edit transitions do not commit or revert.
Use one named input or textarea; do not render both or add a duplicate hidden form value.

commonMistakes.mistake: Saving every draft keystroke as a completed rename.
commonMistakes.correction: Save on commit and preserve application-owned error/retry state.

validation: Test empty/default-edit rollback, controlled transitions, outside cancellation, explicit controls and IME.
Test multiline newlines/modifier submit, native form reset/validation, Field naming and nested dialog focus.
